_metadata.description: Requirement stubs scaffolded from the P2 operational targets.

requirements.description: Per-post engagement telemetry, once social accounts and measurement sources exist. Deferred because it cannot be built or validated before there are live accounts producing measurable posts.
requirements.title: Publish performance ingestion

validation.notes: Deferred: requires live accounts and a measurement source before evidence is meaningful.

requirements.description: Deriving channel-specific variants from one approved draft, so a single verified claim set serves several platform shapes without re-verification.
requirements.title: Per-channel variant derivation

validation.notes: Deferred: a derived variant inherits the parent's verified claim set without re-verification.

requirements.description: Character-consistent and video assets produced by a future asset-production scenario are linked to a draft. Single-image attachment is not this: it moved to P1 through image-tools (D-018). What remains here is the hard problem — identity blocks, drift across frames, and generation spend — which needs persona accounts that do not exist and post types that are all inactive.
requirements.title: Identity-consistent media linkage

validation.notes: Deferred: requires an asset-production scenario to exist before the seam is real.

requirements.description: Proposing hook-library promotions from measured post outcomes rather than editorial taste. Depends on telemetry, so it inherits that deferral.
requirements.title: Outcome-driven hook promotion

validation.notes: Deferred: depends on publish-performance data that does not yet exist.

requirements.title: Conversational draft iteration
requirements.description: Revision is genuinely conversational in a way that workflow actions are not — tighten this hook, cut the third point. Applied in place inside the open editor rather than as a separate chat surface, so the draft stays the object of attention.

validation.notes: An instruction against an open draft produces a new revision with a visible diff and agent author kind.

requirements.title: Desktop packaging
requirements.description: Tier 2 desktop delivery through scenario-to-desktop is the external target, not hosted deployment (D-017). Local-first removes tenancy, a hosted credential surface, and sandboxed check execution by construction; a hosted product would reopen all three at once.

validation.notes: A desktop build starts, reaches the workbench, and reads local storage through the resolver.
